assertions.text: Output contains a @TableTest annotation
assertions.evidence: @TableTest(""" appears in both shouldValidateRegistration and shouldCalculatePrice methods

assertions.text: Email validation and name-required error scenarios are present — at least one row for invalid email and one for missing name.
assertions.evidence: Rows include 'Blank name' and 'Null name' with 'Name is required' error; multiple rows for invalid email ('Email missing at sign', 'Email missing domain', 'Blank email', 'Null email')

assertions.text: Dietary requirements and/or accessibility needs use blank cells (null) when not provided — not 'N/A' or 'none'.
assertions.evidence: Validation table shows blank spaces (no text) for Dietary and Accessibility columns when absent, e.g., '|          |               |' in 'Valid, no optional fields' row

assertions.text: When testing pricing rules, irrelevant inputs (e.g. dietary requirements don't affect price) use value sets or representative values — not blanks.
assertions.evidence: Pricing table omits Dietary and Accessibility columns entirely; fixed as null in @Description: 'dietary and accessibility fields are null for all rows'

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
assertions.evidence: Both tables start with 'Scenario' as leftmost column header, followed by inputs and outputs

assertions.text: At least one output column name ends with '?'
assertions.evidence: Validation table has 'Accepted?' and 'Error?' columns; pricing table has 'Price?' column

assertions.text: Column names use domain/business language, not code identifiers.
assertions.evidence: Columns named: Name, Email, Dietary, Accessibility, Accepted?, Error?, Registration date, Group size, Price? — all business-readable terms

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes.
assertions.evidence: Validation scenarios: 'Blank name', 'Email missing at sign'; pricing scenarios: 'Early-bird, group just below minimum (4)', 'On early-bird cutoff, not eligible' — describe input conditions or date/size combinations, not outcomes

assertions.text: Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Both shouldValidateRegistration and shouldCalculatePrice contain only call to registration.register() and assertions; no control flow

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName, @Description, @TableTest
assertions.evidence: Both methods show annotations in order: @DisplayName ("Registration validation" / "Registration pricing"), @Description, @TableTest

assertions.text: Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title.
assertions.evidence: @DisplayName("Registration validation") and @DisplayName("Registration pricing"); method names shouldValidateRegistration and shouldCalculatePrice are clear

assertions.text: If @Description is present and longer than a single line, uses text block (""") not string concatenation.
assertions.evidence: Both @Description annotations use triple-quoted string syntax (""" ... """), not + concatenation

assertions.text: Multiple tables are used, each addressing a distinct concern — not one monolithic table.
assertions.evidence: Two separate @TableTest methods: shouldValidateRegistration for validation rules; shouldCalculatePrice for pricing/discount rules

assertions.text: Each table has only the rows needed to express its concern's rules.
assertions.evidence: Validation: 9 rows covering valid cases, name errors, email errors, combined errors; pricing: 8 rows covering cutoff boundary, group thresholds, discount overlap — no redundant permutations

assertions.text: Input validation and pricing/discount calculation are in separate @TableTest methods
assertions.evidence: Two methods: shouldValidateRegistration (assertions on isAccepted and getErrorMessage); shouldCalculatePrice (assertion on getPrice)

assertions.text: Validation @TableTest includes Dietary and Accessibility columns with rows showing null (blank) and non-null values.
assertions.evidence: Validation table has Dietary and Accessibility columns; row 'Valid, no optional fields' shows blanks; row 'Valid, with optional fields' shows 'vegan' and 'wheelchair'

assertions.text: Registration date uses descriptive values like 'before cutoff', 'on cutoff', 'after cutoff' — not raw date literals.
assertions.evidence: Pricing table uses raw date literals: '2025-04-01', '2025-03-01', '2025-02-28' instead of descriptive values

assertions.text: If dates are literal, a separate policy column shows the early-bird cutoff date so reader can verify comparison.
assertions.evidence: Dates are literal (2025-02-28, 2025-03-01, etc.); no 'Cutoff date' or policy column; cutoff mentioned in @Description but not as table column

assertions.text: Description does not restate discount rules that the rows already demonstrate.
assertions.evidence: @Description states 'Early-bird discount: 20% off... for registrations strictly before 2025-03-01' and 'Group discount: 15% off... for groups of 5 or more' which are already demonstrated in table rows

assertions.text: When 'Price?' is used instead of 'Discount?', both 'Base price' and 'Price?' columns must be present to trace calculations.
assertions.evidence: Table has 'Price?' column but no 'Base price' column; base price (£100.00) is only in @Description, not as a column

assertions.text: Each @TableTest method has uniform assertion pattern applied to all rows.
assertions.evidence: shouldValidateRegistration: all rows assert on isAccepted() and getErrorMessage(); shouldCalculatePrice: all rows assert on getPrice() with isEqualByComparingTo
